title: DCLab's own models beside a node: a local model shadowing the team's router, scored on the evaluation board
request: Phase 6 (the owner): DCLab's own models as nodes, shadowed first, promoted only where measured better.
plan: A shadow answerer beside the router node, never used.
Every route the team makes a decision, the shadow's answer on it.
The expert's approaches of the journeys as the labels; the evaluation board scores every answerer.

decisions.decision: The shadow on the router node, measured on solution.route.
decisions.why: The programme journeys write the expert's approach for every part: a node with labels is a node a shadow can be scored on.

decisions.decision: A local model (Ollama) as the shadow.
decisions.why: Free, and nothing leaves the Mac; a shadow serves nothing, so no gate is needed to run it, only to promote it.

decisions.decision: The shadow's answer counts only when its model answered.
decisions.why: A rules fallback scored as the model's would credit the rules to the model.

change: capture.route_chosen(shadow=); SolutionTeam(shadow=, shadow_name=) records every route it makes with the shadow's answer; refresh_plan(record=False) when the team recorded; the programme journeys' --shadow-router arm labels each route with the expert's approach and stores the evaluation board.

measurements.name: the dev programme journeys with a local shadow router (JPR-006)
measurements.gate: none fixed: a shadow is measured, never served
measurements.result: 6 of 6 journeys right through the team; on solution.route against the expert's approaches: the rules 31 of 34 (0.912), qwen2.5-coder:1.5b in shadow 5 of 5 answered (19 asked; the rest no valid answer), the solution.route decision student in shadow 34 of 34
measurements.against_gate: Not scored: a shadow's measurement; nothing serves without the sealed gate.
limits: Six people on one replica; the routes recorded at the draft's map and at the team count both.
The 1.5B model answered a quarter of the asks: too few to judge it.
The student's homework may share these journeys' shapes: its score here is not evidence for promotion.

outcome: A node can carry a shadow of DCLab's own models, and its answers are scored beside the rules' on labelled decisions.
lessons: Put a shadow where the decisions have labels: a shadow on an unlabelled node measures only agreement.
risks: A small local model mostly fails the router's format: a larger or tuned one is the next shadow.
